node_definition.done_when:
Find why the diverted fixed-point solve stalls at 2.7e-3, fix it, and make the 282-cell diverted carrier converge to 1e-12. The limited carrier already converges; the diverted carrier is the remaining gate on a two-carrier forward solve.

Where it stands (on main, docs/research/fused-convergence.html, prototype scripts/prototypes/fused_convergence, merged at 2ceb154a3; the read is scripts/prototypes/fast_read):
- Diverted centre (282 cells) starts at scaled residual 0.004696, about its map error of 0.001087 against the analytic certificate. The limited map error is 0.000180.
- An accurate linear step (GMRES to 1e-10, or a dense LU of the cached linearization) raises the nonlinear residual to 1.124. That full trial crosses a class or support change.
- Damped dense or GMRES corrections fall linearly to 0.00268458 after nine accepted corrections. Line-search scales fall from 0.25 to 4.9e-4, and the tenth correction finds no decrease in twelve halvings.
- Every accepted iterate keeps the same 179 support cells, the same saddle identities and the diverted class.
- The residual is dominated by cell 71's current block (-0.00268). Cell 71 is a selected saddle-booking cell, with 7, 8 and 9. Cells 250, 215, 251 and 104 follow at 0.0011 to 0.0015.
- A one-sided Taylor remainder has slope 2 at the centre, so the local JVP is right there. An implicit-root tangent for the cubic-ray intersections changes nothing.
- Removing the saddle moments from the Jacobian (stop_gradient) worsens the stall to 0.00404.
- The lead rules the limited-to-diverted transition continuous: both boundary candidates are computed every step, and no discrete verdict feeds the iteration.

Done when docs/research/diverted-stall.html (reckon-type research, plan-informs converged-forward-solve) reports these H200 measurements on the 282-cell diverted carrier, then the fix:

(1) What the stalled point is.
- At the last accepted iterate, report the norm of the Gauss-Newton gradient (J^T r) relative to the norm of J times the norm of r. A near-zero value with r nonzero means a local minimum of the residual with no root nearby. A large value means the step direction or the map's smoothness fails.
- Scan the residual and cell 71's booked fraction and moments along the Newton direction on a fine grid of step scales, from 1e-6 to 1. Plot them, and locate any kink or jump with the geometric event that causes it: a saddle-region membership change, a four-crossing change, a wall or saddle candidate switch, or a node of the fixed-capacity saddle array.
- Check the Taylor remainder slope at the stalled iterate itself, not only at the centre.

(2) Whether the stall is discretisation.
- Repeat the cold solve at about 550 cells from the certified cache (and at 2,000 if 550 still stalls).
- Report the stall residual and the map error at each size. A stall that tracks the map error, and shrinks with resolution, points at a booking model inconsistent with its own flux. A fixed stall points at a structural defect.

(3) The fix, at the mechanism found. For example: make the saddle normal-form booking and the ordinary cut agree to roundoff where a cell changes hands; smooth the saddle-region selection so membership moves continuously; or correct an inconsistent moment. Do not widen a tolerance, and do not add a branch on topology.
- Then show the diverted cold solve, the warm one- and two-correction neighbours, and the two-correction chord batch at widths 1, 16 and 128 over distinct states, converged to 1e-12 with counts.
- Show the limited carrier and the 41-state sweep validity unchanged.

(4) Figures under docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/diverted-stall, following AGENTS.md plotting rules: the step-scale scan, the stall residual against resolution, and one poloidal line-contour panel per terminal forward state. Each panel shows solved and analytic flux on shared levels, both null sets and the wall, with no axes, and the terminal residual and converged flag in the caption.

Negative controls must re-run the program rather than read a frozen receipt:
- reverting the fix reproduces the 2.7e-3 stall, so its row turns red;
- the analytic oracle remains independent of the solved state.

Write only scripts/prototypes/diverted_stall, docs/research/diverted-stall.html, docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/diverted-stall and docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/diverted-stall.html, with plan-evidence-for converged-forward-solve. Import, but do not edit, scripts/prototypes/{fast_read,fused_convergence,fused_newton,read_robustness,sub_millisecond,lean_map} and nova/. If the fix belongs in an imported prototype module, carry a corrected copy under scripts/prototypes/diverted_stall and say which function it replaces. Do not change nova/ product code, and do not touch the held moment-space Newton worktree. reckon audit-doc must report 0 errors.

Run conditions: H200 rows run as one job through RECKON_ALLOW_NESTED_LAUNCH=1 scripts/h200_test_lane/run.sh --log (an absolute path in the run directory) --wait -- (targets), or one sbatch job on --partition=betelgeuse --reservation=gpu_0003_grpA --gres=gpu:1 with rungs as rows inside the allocation (never an array), --time sized to finish, XLA_PYTHON_CLIENT_PREALLOCATE=false and TMPDIR=/tmp in the submit environment and in every child; submit for real and read squeue a minute later rather than trusting sbatch --test-only. On a compute node run /home/ITER/mcintos/Code/nova/.venv/bin/python directly with PYTHONPATH set to the run worktree and never invoke uv; every login-node uv command carries --no-sync and nothing runs uv sync. configure_dtypes() before any array and jax_enable_x64 asserted True. Gates pass by delta against orientation_base_sha in per-module fresh processes, both arms running the same test files with the repository root conftest, baseline_suite and after_suite as single-line JSON whose log_path names one log file and whose command is literally runnable. Any wait is declared on the job that finishes last as wait_probe ["sacct","-n","-X","-P","-j","(job id)","-o","State"] and wait_terminal ["COMPLETED","FAILED","CANCELLED","TIMEOUT","OUT_OF_MEMORY","NODE_FAIL"] as JSON lists, and names every job it depends on in wait_condition. The certified 550, 2,000 and 5,000-cell machines and exteriors are cached under /home/ITER/mcintos/.config/reckon/crew/runs/r-20261009T181553786165-proto-support/ordered/rows/cache and may be read in place, never written. Run filepath relativize over any evidence fragment before committing. Commit with conventional subjects and bodies at every step and write the manifest and commit before every job wait; the manifest commits line lists every commit; status is complete, blocked or failed, which the worker sets itself. No plan labels in source names or comments. Inside every job payload, make one directory with mktemp -d /tmp/$USER-$SLURM_JOB_ID-XXXX, point TMPDIR at it, and remove it on exit with trap 'rm -rf' (keep TMPDIR=/tmp in the submit environment so slurmstepd can start). Never leave extracted base trees or caches in /tmp after a node ends; anything a later reader needs goes under the run directory on GPFS.

Import provenance: print nova.__file__ in every log header. On the fleet allocation (SLURM_JOB_ID set), run CPU work in place. The time budget is per working turn, not a deadline: park on H200 jobs with declared waits and continue across turns; this node is sized at about 8 worker-hours, and an unmeasured item in your own scope is remaining work, not a blocker. Never edit a script a submitted job will run; submit a per-job copy. Size every job memory from a measured row. The manifest commits line lists every commit (git rev-list), orientation_base_sha is copied from git rev-parse output, and status is complete when the record is delivered even if the target is not met (then give the nearest measured figure and what dominates it).
